description.value: Puerto Vallarta Amigos is a family-run Mexican food business rooted in the Espinoza family's restaurant heritage from Acapulco, Morelia, and Puerto Vallarta, operating multiple Victoria locations including this kiosk at Uptown Shopping Centre. The menu centres on tacos, quesadillas, tostadas, and burritos made from generational family recipes, with fish tacos and seafood as house specialties alongside a full range of vegetarian and vegan options. The business describes itself as a pioneer of Victoria's food truck scene, with additional fixed locations at Fisherman's Wharf and the Royal BC Museum.
